title: Dashboard KPI tiles bound to a dataset show money values with no currency
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzC6RxMfB59EsgAoNN

Filing gate: ③ a triage-directed split. Triage on #27520 (6495077487) says: "Each row is either taken, with its own card where it needs code, or answered will-not-do; money-format rows 15/16 belong with #27430." #27430 is closed, and this case is still open on `main`. It was found by the #27520 card thread (os-dev-report 6529089724, out-of-scope finding, browser read).
Business reason: a sales manager on the CRM Pipeline dashboard reads `710,000`, `235,000` and `81,000` on the KPI tiles with no currency. On a multi-currency org the reader can't tell which currency the pipeline total is in, or whether it is money at all. That is the headline number of the dashboard.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`).
Duplicate search: open issues with "dataset KPI currency" / "metric tile money format" / "KPI currency" found none open. #27430 is closed. **New.**

## What happens (row 15 money half of #27520)

Admin, desktop and phone, `examples/app-crm` Pipeline dashboard on `main` `9f13ee81`: the dataset-bound KPI tiles render `710,000` / `235,000` / `81,000`, a bare number with no currency.

## Mechanism (read, not yet measured to the line)

- #27430 (PR #27972) gave the tile its caption and a currency face for a formula declared `returnType: 'currency'`. A KPI tile bound to a **dataset** measure doesn't take that path. Measure where the dataset tile (`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`, `metricTile.ts`) formats its value, and whether the dataset answer carries the measure's field type and currency.
- Serial: PR #28223 (#27520 rows 3/15/18) edits `DatasetWidget.tsx` and `metricTile.ts` (the tile's value-scale ladder). Dispatch this after it lands.

## Expected

A money measure on a KPI tile shows its currency (the field's currency, or the org default), with the same compact ladder #28223 adds.

Blocked-by: #28223
